notes.title: Patch v１.0.1 is set live now!
notes.content:
Hello!

We just set patch v1.0.1 live!

[1.0.1] Patch Notes
- Adjusted the volume of coin collection sound effects
- Fixed a bug where best clear times were not updating properly on the result screen
- Fixed various text issues

Thank you for your continued support of Tokyo Waning Moon!

Best regards,
Ayumi

notes.title: Tokyo Waning Moon is out now!
notes.content:
Tokyo Waning Moon is out now! 🎉

Thanks to everyone who wishlisted, or  supported us on social media - we couldn't have made it to release day without you!

Tonight in Tokyo is actually a waning moon... just like our title! 
We hope you enjoy the game!

Regarding Let's Plays and Livestreams
Feel free to stream or create content! Monetization is OK.

Need logos or key visuals? You can grab them here:
Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cegv5nBDas-Rk40rZr9YTy_oCujfkWde

I'd love to see your streams and videos if you make them!


Developer's X: https://x.com/MCupcakeTokyo

Contact: https://www.midnight-cupcakes.com/contacts


Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or find any issues!

Thank you,
Ayumi

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
The demo version of "Tokyo Waning Moon" is now available!

Demo Version
In the free demo version, you can enjoy the following features: 

Gameplay up to the mid-boss "Crazy Truck"
Power-Up of certain parameters by using collected coins 

Please download it from the store page! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295300/Tokyo_Waning_Moon/


Scheduled Steam Next Fest Developer LIVE Stream!
okyo Waning Moon will be participating in the Steam Next Fest in February. Developer Ayumi will be taking on live gameplay of the demo version according to the following schedule. 

February 6th (Tue) from 7:00 PM PST (February 7th, 12:00 PM JST)
February 8th (Thu) from 7:00 PM PST (February 9th, 12:00 PM JST)
